definitions: To become known or be revealed.
To leave a place, especially to go to a social event.
To declare oneself to be lesbian, gay, bisexual, or transgender.
To emerge from a place or container.
examples: The truth finally came out after years of speculation.
Her new book came out last week.
We came out for a drink last night.
He came out to his family when he was eighteen.
The sun came out from behind the clouds.
